ei.title: 성격 일관성의 진화적 부적응성과 행동 유연성의 한계

fullPassage: Consistent individual differences in behavior within populations, also known as personality, are attracting the attention of many evolutionary biologists. One of the reasons why personality is interesting from an evolutionary perspective is that behaving in a consistent way across a variety of contexts or through time seems maladaptive. At some point, a mismatch between an individual's behavior and the optimal strategy for a given situation may be expected. For example, an individual that is consistently uninhibited and bold will at some point incur an elevated risk of predation; the optimal individual should be bold only when it makes sense to be bold, and adjust its behavior when the situation changes. However, personality implies that individuals are limited in their behavioral plasticity; the individuals that are, for example, particularly active in the absence of predation risk are also those that are most active in the presence of predation risk. From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be harmful as optimal individuals should adapt their behavior to changing circumstances, yet the persistence of personality suggests a limit to behavioral flexibility.

questions.passage: Consistent individual differences in behavior within populations, also known as personality, are attracting the attention of many evolutionary biologists. One of the reasons why personality is interesting from an evolutionary perspective is that behaving in a (A)[consistent / inconsistent] way across a variety of contexts or through time seems maladaptive. At some point, a mismatch between an individual's behavior and the (B)[optimal / minimal] strategy for a given situation may be expected. For example, an individual that is consistently uninhibited and bold will at some point incur an (C)[elevated / reduced] risk of predation; the optimal individual should be bold only when it makes sense to be bold, and adjust its behavior when the situation changes. However, personality implies that individuals are limited in their behavioral plasticity; the individuals that are, for example, particularly active in the absence of predation risk are also those that are most active in the presence of predation risk. From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be harmful as optimal individuals should adapt their behavior to changing circumstances, yet the persistence of personality suggests a limit to behavioral flexibility.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 일관된(consistent), 최적의(optimal), 높아진(elevated).
det.analysis:
✅ ① consistent — optimal — elevated: 일관된 방식의 행동이 부적응적이고, 최적의 전략과 불일치하며, 높아진 포식 위험을 초래한다.
❌ ② inconsistent — optimal — elevated: inconsistent는 '비일관적'으로 본문의 consistent와 반대.
❌ ③ consistent — minimal — elevated: minimal(최소의)은 optimal(최적의)과 다른 의미.
❌ ④ consistent — optimal — reduced: reduced(줄어든)는 elevated(높아진)의 반의어.
det.tip: consistent(일관된) ↔ inconsistent(비일관적). optimal(최적의) ↔ minimal(최소의). elevated(높아진) ↔ reduced(줄어든).

questions.passage: Consistent individual differences in behavior within populations, also known as personality, are attracting the attention of many evolutionary biologists. One of the reasons why personality is interesting from an evolutionary perspective is that behaving in a consistent way across a variety of contexts or through time seems maladaptive. At some point, a mismatch between an individual's behavior and the optimal strategy for a given situation may be expected. For example, an individual that is consistently uninhibited and bold will at some point incur an elevated risk of predation; the optimal individual should be bold only when it makes sense to be bold, and (A)[adjust / maintain] its behavior when the situation changes. However, personality implies that individuals are (B)[limited / enhanced] in their behavioral plasticity; the individuals that are, for example, particularly active in the absence of predation risk are also those that are most active in the presence of predation risk. From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be (C)[harmful / beneficial] as optimal individuals should adapt their behavior to changing circumstances, yet the persistence of personality suggests a limit to behavioral flexibility.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 조정하다(adjust), 제한된(limited), 해로운(harmful).
det.analysis:
✅ ② adjust — limited — harmful: 최적 개체는 행동을 '조정'해야 하고, 성격은 유연성이 '제한됨'을 의미하며, 성격은 '해로울' 수 있다.
❌ ① maintain — limited — harmful: maintain(유지하다)은 adjust(조정하다)와 반대.
❌ ③ adjust — enhanced — harmful: enhanced(향상된)는 limited(제한된)의 반의어.
❌ ④ adjust — limited — beneficial: beneficial(유익한)은 harmful(해로운)의 반의어.
det.tip: adjust(조정하다) = adapt, modify ↔ maintain(유지하다). limited(제한된) ↔ enhanced(향상된).

questions.passage: Consistent individual differences in behavior within populations, also known as personality, are attracting the attention of many evolutionary biologists. One of the reasons why personality is interesting from an evolutionary perspective is that behaving in a consistent way across a variety of contexts or through time seems (A)[maladaptive / adaptive]. At some point, a mismatch between an individual's behavior and the optimal strategy for a given situation may be expected. For example, an individual that is consistently uninhibited and bold will at some point incur an elevated risk of predation; the optimal individual should be bold only when it makes sense to be bold, and adjust its behavior when the situation changes. However, personality implies that individuals are limited in their behavioral (B)[plasticity / rigidity]; the individuals that are, for example, particularly active in the absence of predation risk are also those that are most active in the (C)[presence / absence] of predation risk. From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be harmful as optimal individuals should adapt their behavior to changing circumstances, yet the persistence of personality suggests a limit to behavioral flexibility.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 부적응적(maladaptive), 가소성(plasticity), 존재(presence).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ maladaptive — plasticity — presence: 일관된 행동은 '부적응적'이고, 행동 '가소성'이 제한되며, 포식 위험의 '존재' 하에서도 활동적이다.
❌ ① adaptive — plasticity — presence: adaptive(적응적)은 maladaptive(부적응적)의 반의어.
❌ ② maladaptive — rigidity — presence: rigidity(경직성)는 limited in their rigidity(경직성이 제한됨)가 되어 문맥 반대.
❌ ④ maladaptive — plasticity — absence: absence(부재)이면 앞의 absence와 중복되어 대비 구조가 깨짐.
det.tip: maladaptive(부적응적) = mal- + adaptive. plasticity(가소성) ≈ flexibility(유연성). presence(존재) ↔ absence(부재).

questions.passage: Consistent individual differences in behavior within populations, also known as personality, are attracting the attention of many evolutionary biologists. One of the reasons why personality is interesting from an evolutionary perspective is that behaving in a consistent way across a variety of contexts or through time seems maladaptive. At some point, a ①<u>mismatch</u> between an individual's behavior and the optimal strategy for a given situation may be expected. For example, an individual that is consistently uninhibited and bold will at some point incur an ②<u>elevated</u> risk of predation; the optimal individual should be bold only when it makes sense to be bold, and adjust its behavior when the situation changes. However, personality implies that individuals are limited in their behavioral plasticity; the individuals that are, for example, particularly ③<u>inactive</u> in the absence of predation risk are also those that are most active in the presence of predation risk. From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be harmful as optimal individuals should adapt their behavior to changing circumstances, yet the persistence of personality suggests a limit to behavioral ④<u>flexibility</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ inactive → active: 포식 위험이 없을 때 '활동적인' 개체가 위험이 있을 때도 활동적이라는 대비입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① mismatch: 행동과 전략의 '불일치' — 적절.
✅ ② elevated: '높아진' 포식 위험 — 적절.
❌ ③ inactive → active: 포식 위험이 없을 때 '비활동적'이면 위험 있을 때 '가장 활동적'이라는 결론이 성격 일관성 논지와 모순. 원문은 active(활동적). ← 정답
✅ ④ flexibility: 행동 '유연성'의 한계 — 적절.
det.tip: active(활동적인) ↔ inactive(비활동적인). 원문 핵심: 위험 유무와 무관하게 동일하게 활동적.

questions.passage: Consistent individual differences in behavior within populations, also known as personality, are attracting the attention of many evolutionary biologists. One of the reasons why personality is interesting from an evolutionary perspective is that behaving in a consistent way across a variety of contexts or through time seems ①<u>maladaptive</u>. At some point, a mismatch between an individual's behavior and the optimal strategy for a given situation may be expected. For example, an individual that is consistently ②<u>uninhibited</u> and bold will at some point incur an elevated risk of predation; the optimal individual should be bold only when it makes sense to be bold, and adjust its behavior when the situation changes. However, personality implies that individuals are limited in their behavioral plasticity; the individuals that are, for example, particularly active in the absence of predation risk are also those that are most active in the presence of predation risk. From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be harmful as optimal individuals should ③<u>adapt</u> their behavior to changing circumstances, yet the ④<u>disappearance</u> of personality suggests a limit to behavioral flexibility.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ disappearance → persistence: 성격의 '사라짐'이 아니라 '지속'이 행동 유연성의 한계를 시사합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① maladaptive: 일관된 행동이 '부적응적' — 적절.
✅ ② uninhibited: '거침없는, 억제되지 않은' — 적절.
✅ ③ adapt: 행동을 상황에 '적응시키다' — 적절.
❌ ④ disappearance → persistence: 성격이 '사라진다'면 유연성 한계를 시사할 수 없음. '지속(persistence)'이 올바름. ← 정답
det.tip: persistence(지속) ↔ disappearance(사라짐). 성격이 지속되기에 유연성에 한계가 있다.

questions.passage: Consistent individual differences in behavior within populations, also known as personality, are attracting the attention of many evolutionary biologists. One of the reasons why personality is interesting from an evolutionary perspective is that behaving in a consistent way across a variety of contexts or through time seems maladaptive. At some point, a mismatch between an individual's behavior and the optimal strategy for a given situation may be expected. However, personality implies that individuals are ③<u>limited</u> in their behavioral plasticity; the individuals that are, for example, particularly active in the ④<u>absence</u> of predation risk are also those that are most active in the presence of predation risk. From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be harmful as optimal individuals should adapt their behavior to ①<u>unchanging</u> circumstances, yet the persistence of personality suggests a limit to behavioral flexibility.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① unchanging → changing: 최적의 개체는 '변화하는' 상황에 적응해야 합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ incur: 위험을 '초래하다' — 적절.
✅ ② limited: 유연성이 '제한된' — 적절.
✅ ③ absence: 포식 위험의 '부재' — 적절.
❌ ① unchanging → changing: '변하지 않는' 상황에 적응할 필요가 없음. '변화하는(changing)' 상황이어야 적응이 의미 있음. ← 정답
det.tip: changing(변화하는) ↔ unchanging(변하지 않는). adapt to changing circumstances = 변화하는 상황에 적응하다.

From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be harmful as optimal individuals should adapt their behavior to changing circumstances, yet the persistence of personality suggests a limit to behavioral flexibility.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 부적응적인(maladaptive): 일관된 행동은 '부적응적'으로 보입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② maladaptive: 뒤에서 mismatch(불일치), elevated risk(위험 증가), harmful(해로움)으로 뒷받침. seems의 보어로 형용사 적절.
❌ ① optimal: '최적의'는 부적응적이라는 전체 논지와 반대.
❌ ③ consistent: '일관된'은 동어반복(behaving in a consistent way seems consistent).
❌ ④ evolutionary: '진화적인'은 seems의 보어로 의미가 통하지 않음.
det.tip: maladaptive = mal-(나쁜) + adaptive(적응적인) → 부적응적인. 핵심: 일관된 행동 → 부적응적.

From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be harmful as optimal individuals should adapt their behavior to changing circumstances, yet the persistence of personality suggests a limit to behavioral flexibility.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 불일치(mismatch): 개체의 행동과 최적 전략 간의 '불일치'가 예상됩니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① mismatch: 일관된 행동이 부적응적이므로 행동과 최적 전략 간 '불일치'가 발생. 'between A and B'와 자연스럽게 연결.
❌ ② persistence: '지속'은 between A and B 구조에 부적절.
❌ ③ plasticity: '유연성'은 행동과 전략 사이의 관계를 나타내지 않음.
❌ ④ flexibility: '유연성'도 마찬가지로 부적절.
det.tip: mismatch(불일치) = discrepancy, gap. a mismatch between A and B = A와 B 간의 불일치.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 초래하다(incur): 대담한 개체는 높아진 포식 위험을 '초래'합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② incur: 'incur a risk'는 '위험을 초래하다/떠안다'로 자연스러움. 대담한 행동의 부정적 결과를 나타냄.
❌ ① avoid: '피하다'는 위험을 높인다는 문맥과 반대.
❌ ③ adapt: '적응하다'는 adapt a risk 형태로 쓰이지 않음.
❌ ④ adjust: '조정하다'도 adjust a risk 형태로 쓰이지 않음.
det.tip: incur(초래하다, 떠안다) = bring upon oneself. incur a risk/cost/debt. 본문에서 incur와 함께 쓰이는 단어: elevated, risk, predation.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>attracting</u>과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 끌다(attracting) = drawing.
det.analysis:
✅ ① drawing: '끌어당기다'로 attracting과 동의어. draw attention = attract attention.
❌ ② repelling: '밀어내다'는 attracting의 반의어.
❌ ③ losing: '잃다'는 관심을 잃는다는 의미로 반대.
❌ ④ ignoring: '무시하다'는 관심과 반대.
det.tip: attract(끌다) = draw, capture ↔ repel(밀어내다). attract attention = 관심을 끌다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>adjust</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 조정하다(adjust) = modify.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ modify: '수정하다, 조정하다'로 adjust와 동의어.
❌ ① maintain: '유지하다'는 조정하다와 반대.
❌ ② abandon: '포기하다'는 행동 조정과 다른 극단적 의미.
❌ ④ reinforce: '강화하다'는 조정이 아니라 강화.
det.tip: adjust(조정하다) = modify, adapt, alter ↔ maintain(유지하다), fix(고정하다).

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>implies</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 암시하다(implies) = suggests.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ suggests: '시사하다, 암시하다'로 implies와 동의어.
❌ ① denies: '부정하다'는 implies와 반대.
❌ ② demands: '요구하다'는 논리적 함의가 아니라 명시적 요구.
❌ ③ contradicts: '모순되다'는 암시와 다른 의미.
det.tip: imply(암시하다) = suggest, indicate, hint ↔ deny(부정하다), state explicitly(명시하다).

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>consistent</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 일관된(consistent)의 반의어 = variable.
det.analysis:
✅ ② variable: '가변적인, 변하는'으로 consistent의 정확한 반의어.
❌ ① steady: '안정된, 꾸준한'은 consistent의 동의어.
❌ ③ uniform: '균일한'도 consistent의 유사어.
❌ ④ constant: '변함없는'도 consistent의 동의어.
det.tip: consistent(일관된) = steady, constant, uniform ↔ variable(가변적인), erratic(불규칙적인), inconsistent(비일관적인).

One of the reasons why personality is interesting from an evolutionary perspective is that behaving in a consistent way across a variety of contexts or through time seems maladaptive. At some point, a mismatch between an individual's behavior and the optimal strategy for a given situation may be expected. For example, an individual that is consistently uninhibited and bold will at some point incur an elevated risk of predation; the optimal individual should be bold only when it makes sense to be bold, and adjust its behavior when the situation changes. However, personality implies that individuals are limited in their behavioral plasticity; the individuals that are, for example, particularly active in the absence of predation risk are also those that are most active in the presence of predation risk. From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be <u>harmful</u> as optimal individuals should adapt their behavior to changing circumstances, yet the persistence of personality suggests a limit to behavioral flexibility.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>harmful</u>과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 해로운(harmful)의 반의어 = beneficial.
det.analysis:
✅ ① beneficial: '유익한'으로 harmful의 정확한 반의어.
❌ ② dangerous: '위험한'은 harmful의 유사어.
❌ ③ detrimental: '해로운'도 harmful의 동의어.
❌ ④ destructive: '파괴적인'도 harmful의 유사어.
det.tip: harmful(해로운) = detrimental, dangerous, destructive ↔ beneficial(유익한), advantageous(유리한).

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 risk가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 위험, 가능성 (명사) (B) 위험을 무릅쓰다 (동사).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 위험, 가능성 — (B) 위험을 무릅쓰다: (A)에서 risk는 '포식의 위험'이라는 명사, (B)에서 risk는 '~을 감행하다'라는 동사.
❌ ① (A) 위험을 무릅쓰다 — (B) 위험, 가능성: (A)(B) 의미가 뒤바뀜.
❌ ② (A) 모험 — (B) 손실: 둘 다 부정확.
❌ ④ (A) 손해 — (B) 모험: (A)의 risk는 손해가 아니라 가능성/위험.
det.tip: risk (명사): 위험, 가능성 — an elevated risk of. risk (동사): 위험을 무릅쓰다 — risk + V-ing.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the ability of an organism to change its behavior in response to changes in the environment"

det.korean: plasticity (가소성, 유연성): 환경 변화에 대응하여 행동을 바꿀 수 있는 능력.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ plasticity: '유기체가 환경 변화에 반응하여 행동을 바꿀 수 있는 능력'에 정확히 부합.
❌ ① personality: '성격'은 일관된 행동 특성이지 유연한 변화 능력이 아님.
❌ ② persistence: '지속성'은 변화가 아니라 유지.
❌ ③ predation: '포식'은 다른 동물을 잡아먹는 행위.
det.tip: plasticity = 가소성, 유연성 (행동/뇌 등이 변화할 수 있는 성질). behavioral plasticity = 행동 유연성.

questions.passage: At some point, a mismatch between an individual's behavior and the optimal strategy for a given situation may be expected. For example, an individual that is consistently uninhibited and bold will at some point incur an elevated risk of __________. (predate)
questions.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: predate → predation: 'risk of' 뒤에 명사가 필요하므로 동사 predate → 명사 predation(포식).
det.analysis: 전치사 of 뒤에는 명사가 필요. predate(포식하다, 동사) → predation(포식, 명사). an elevated risk of predation = 높아진 포식의 위험.
det.tip: predate(동사: 포식하다) → predation(명사: 포식). -tion 접미사는 동사 → 명사 변환.

questions.passage: From an evolutionary perspective, personality may be harmful as optimal individuals should adapt their behavior to changing circumstances, yet the __________ (persist) of personality suggests a limit to behavioral flexibility.
questions.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: persist → persistence: 관사 the 뒤에 명사가 필요하므로 동사 persist → 명사 persistence(지속).
det.analysis: the + 빈칸 + of personality 구조에서 명사 필요. persist(지속하다, 동사) → persistence(지속, 명사). the persistence of personality = 성격의 지속.
det.tip: persist(동사: 지속하다) → persistence(명사: 지속). persistent(형용사: 지속적인).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 포식 위험의 부재 시(in the absence of predation risk): 위험이 없을 때 활동적인 개체가 위험이 있을 때도 활동적이라는 대비.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ in the absence of predation risk: 뒤의 'in the presence of predation risk'와 대비. 위험 부재 시 활동적 → 위험 존재 시에도 활동적.
❌ ① in the presence of predation risk: 이미 뒤에 나옴. 같은 구를 반복하면 대비 구조가 깨짐.
❌ ② across a variety of contexts: 본문에 있지만 '다양한 맥락에서'는 빈칸 위치의 구체적 예시와 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ from an evolutionary perspective: 본문에 있지만 '진화적 관점에서'는 활동성의 조건을 나타내지 않음.
det.tip: absence(부재) ↔ presence(존재). 대비 구조: in the absence of A ... in the presence of A.
